messages.content: I keep sabotaging good things in my life right when they start going well.
That pattern usually isn't random, there's often a reason underneath it. Does it feel more like fear of it not lasting, or feeling undeserving of it going well?
Probably feeling undeserving, like good things aren't supposed to last for me.

That belief had to come from somewhere, it doesn't just appear out of nowhere. Naming it clearly like you just did is actually a meaningful first step — the sabotage loses some power once you can see it happening in real time instead of it just feeling like bad luck.
